instagram.caption:
What if Joel walked out of a Vault?

Joel steps out of Vault 111 and tells Dogmeat to stay close, because he has done this apocalypse before. Ghouls are just slow Clickers to him. Then a Deathclaw shows up and Joel quietly reloads his revolver. Does Joel survive the Commonwealth, or does the Fallout wasteland finally break him?
